About.description: A shared workspace to organize projects and customers, manage access, and work with your data.
About.signIn: Sign in or create an account
About.controlsDescription: Permissions are checked for each operation. Owners can manage members, review billing, and prepare exports or deletion requests.
About.configurationNotice: Integrations and optional services depend on each installation’s configuration.

Help.title: Help center
Help.dataDescription: In a project, upload UTF-8 text or CSV up to 1 MiB. Finish verification before using it. In Data, map columns, run validation, and review row errors. Jobs support up to 1,000 rows; you can cancel or retry with current access.
Help.exportsDescription: Exports expire after 24 hours. If your permissions or source data change, generate a new export.
Help.privacyDescription: In Privacy you can change optional notifications and analytics. Before deleting your account, transfer organizations where you are the sole owner. A prepared request can be canceled; confirmed deletion revokes access and cannot be undone.
Help.integrationsDescription: Owners and administrators can configure approved HTTPS destinations. Verify webhooks before use and save secrets when created or rotated. Audit access requires an additional permission granted by an owner.
Help.accessDescription: Confirm your identity for sensitive changes. If an organization needs owner recovery, contact your installation administrator. Recovery requires independent verification; do not share passwords or recovery codes.

Common.failed: Could not complete. Check your access, confirm your identity, and try again.

Data.title: Organization data
Data.expiryNotice: Exports expire after 24 hours. Jobs check your current access at each step.
Data.auditNotice: Audit exports require an additional owner-granted permission.
Data.importHint: First upload a CSV in a project’s files. Maximum 1,000 rows and 1 MiB.
Data.rowsChecked: {count, plural, one {# row checked} other {# rows checked}}

Privacy.title: Privacy and preferences
Privacy.suppressed: Optional email is suppressed after an unsubscribe, bounce, or complaint.
Privacy.mandatoryNotice: Mandatory security and billing notices follow their own rules.
Privacy.deleteOrganizationDescription: The organization is suspended and its data is deleted. Subscription cancellation is confirmed with the provider; it may remain pending until the contracted period ends. Export the data you need first.
Privacy.deleteAccountDescription: Before deleting your account, each organization where you are the sole owner must have a verified successor or complete deletion. Shared organizations and their subscriptions are preserved.
Privacy.retentionNotice: Restricted security and financial records are retained. Backups expire under the storage policy; this status does not certify their erasure.
Privacy.saveReceipt: Save this status link. It only allows viewing this request.
Privacy.deletionConsent: I understand that confirmation revokes access and starts irreversible deletion.

Settings.title: Organization settings
Settings.freshAuthNotice: Sensitive changes require identity confirmation within the last five minutes.
Settings.saveSecret: Save this secret now. It is shown only once.
Settings.collectionDisabled: Collection is disabled for this installation.
Settings.analyticsConsent: Allow optional analytics for this organization
Settings.webhooksHint: The installation administrator must allow the HTTPS domain. The endpoint must echo the verification challenge.
Settings.name: Name
Settings.integrationsHint: Connect an HTTPS endpoint that supports connection.health. Declared scopes must match the provider’s permissions.
Settings.auditHint: Only an owner can grant this additional permission to owners or administrators.

Widget.title: Help and notifications
Widget.contact: For help with this organization, contact your installation administrator and share only the failed request identifier.

Platform.hint: Search project and customer names in this organization.
Platform.empty: No accessible results on this page.
Platform.failed: Could not load this page. Try again or sign in to refresh your access.

Keys.title: API keys
Keys.hint: Manage service accounts and expiring credentials. Creating or changing credentials requires authentication within the last five minutes.
Keys.name: Service account name
Keys.readAll: Allow reading every project in this organization
Keys.createAll: Allow creating projects in this organization
Keys.failed: The request failed. Check your access and sign in again if fresh authentication is required.
Keys.secret: Copy this secret now. It will not be shown again.
Keys.confirmRevoke: Revoke this key now? Existing integrations using it will lose access.
Keys.confirmRotate: Rotate this key now? The old key will stop working immediately.
Keys.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate this account and revoke all its keys?
Keys.unavailable: The secret may have been issued but its response was lost. Refresh the list and revoke or rotate the key; secrets cannot be retrieved.

Files.title: Files
Files.hint: UTF-8 text or CSV, up to 1 MiB. Available files expire after 30 days.
Files.failed: The operation could not be completed. Check access or try again.
Files.invalid: Choose a UTF-8 .txt or .csv file between 1 byte and 1 MiB.
